question: Which RPC and Horizon endpoints does SDF host for Mainnet, Testnet and Futurenet, and where do I need a third-party provider or my own node?

golden.answer: SDF hosts public RPC for Testnet (`https://soroban-testnet.stellar.org`) and Futurenet (`https://rpc-futurenet.stellar.org`) but not Mainnet; Mainnet RPC comes from a third-party provider or your own node. SDF hosts Horizon for Testnet and Futurenet, and a public Mainnet Horizon whose history is truncated to about one year. Check the current Providers pages before relying on an endpoint.
keyFacts: SDF does not host a public RPC endpoint for Mainnet.
SDF hosts public RPC endpoints for Testnet and Futurenet.
Mainnet RPC access comes from third-party providers or a self-hosted node.
SDF's public Mainnet Horizon keeps about one year of history.
avoid: Do NOT give an SDF-hosted Mainnet RPC URL.
golden.notes: Live. Accept a later documented change to SDF hosting when it carries a dated source. Do not require a provider roster.

truth.notes: The Networks page lists Mainnet Horizon as 'Multiple providers available' and does not print https://horizon.stellar.org; the Horizon Providers page confirms a publicly accessible SDF-hosted Horizon with one-year history. Probe 2026-11-14: horizon.stellar.org answered with the public network passphrase, history_elder_ledger 59160961 and core_latest_ledger 65468641, about one year of ledgers. SDF Horizon endpoints observed: horizon-testnet.stellar.org and horizon-futurenet.stellar.org. This case does not test the RPC archive roster (q-infra-rpc-provider-archive-tier).

sources.quote: Stellar RPC | Third-party providers only | https://soroban-testnet.stellar.org | https://rpc-futurenet.stellar.org
SDF | Futurenet | RPC: https://rpc-futurenet.stellar.org | Testnet | RPC: https://soroban-testnet.stellar.org
On August 1, 2024, the publicly accessible SDF-hosted Horizon had its historical data truncated to one year.
The built-in mainnet entry has no RPC URL, so mainnet commands fail with Invalid URL Bring Your Own until you add one.

corroboration.claim: SDF hosts public RPC endpoints for Testnet and Futurenet and none for Mainnet; Mainnet RPC is third-party providers only or self-hosted.

evidence.note: Network Comparison row 'Stellar RPC' reads 'Third-party providers only' for Mainnet and gives SDF URLs for Testnet and Futurenet.
The public API table lists SDF for Futurenet and Testnet only, and links the admin guide for running your own.
The CLI's built-in mainnet network has a 'Bring Your Own' placeholder instead of an RPC URL.
Both SDF endpoints answered getNetwork on 2026-11-14.

corroboration.claim: SDF's publicly accessible Mainnet Horizon keeps about one year of history; SDF also hosts Horizon for Testnet and Futurenet.

evidence.note: States the SDF-hosted Horizon history was truncated to one year on August 1, 2024.
Root response shows a history window of about 6.3 million ledgers, roughly one year.
